issue_title: Homepage performance persistently below 85 for 11+ consecutive audits (LCP > 6.7 s); /projects and /screenshot-to-primevue also dropped below 85
issue_body:
## Performance Regressions — Multiple Pages Below 85

**Audited:** 2026-08-06T10:50:29.640Z

### Homepage (/) — 11th consecutive audit below 85
| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Performance | 73 |
| LCP | 6787 ms |
| CLS | 0.015 |
| TBT | 144 ms |

The homepage has scored 72–73 on every audit for at least 11 consecutive runs, with LCP consistently above 6.1 s. LCP actually worsened this run (+625 ms). No structural fix has been applied.

### /projects — New regression this audit
| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Performance | 80 (was 90, -10 pts) |
| LCP | 3888 ms (was 3087 ms, +801 ms) |
| TBT | 127.5 ms (was 83.5 ms) |

A 10-point drop in one audit cycle warrants investigation. The projects index now has a new "Token Field" featured build — check whether its assets are unoptimised.

### /projects/screenshot-to-primevue — New regression this audit
| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Performance | 79 (was 90, -11 pts) |
| LCP | 4142 ms (was 3175 ms, +967 ms) |

An 11-point drop in one audit cycle. Likely related to heavier assets or a newly introduced dependency.

### Recommended fixes
1. **Homepage LCP:** Add `<link rel="preload" as="image" href="...hero...">` in `<head>`, serve hero in WebP/AVIF sized for mobile (≤ 800 px wide), defer render-blocking JS/CSS.
2. **Investigate /projects and /screenshot-to-primevue regressions:** Check for newly added unoptimised images or JS bundles introduced alongside the Token Field project; ensure project thumbnail images are lazy-loaded below the fold.
3. **Stub /about page:** Replace placeholder text with real content, nav, and footer.
